lines.latin: Udawalawa Jathika Udyanayata Sadarayen Piliganimu (Welcome to Udawalawa National Park)

notes: Black welcome board at the park among tall grass, slight angle; the sign spells it 'Udawalawa' while OSM/common spelling is Udawalawe. Not labelled: the seven prohibition pictograms with captions (DO NOT FIRE, DO NOT LITTER, DO NOT FEED ANIMALS, DO NOT SHOUT, ALCOHOL IS PROHIBITED, NO PETS ALLOWED, DO NOT ALIGHT THE VEHICLE) and the sponsor strip (Department of Wildlife Conservation, Young Zoologists' Association of Sri Lanka, L B FINANCE).

author: Indi Samarajiva
attribution: Photo: Indi Samarajiva, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jaffna_Art_Shop.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted shop boards in Jaffna. Line 1 is the stylised red title of the big blue board (lettering mixes lower- and upper-case forms). Lines 2-4 are the hanging blade sign at right (with a left arrow before ART); a tiny yellow word before வீமா is not legible and is omitted. The Tamil service list on the big board (rubber stamps, advertising boards, banners, vehicle number stickers, 'all done in 3 languages') is advertising copy and not labelled. Distractors: the neighbouring Tamil board at far left and the faded '...கலையகம்' studio board behind.
source_categories: Bilingual English-Tamil signs in Sri Lanka

Pedestrians at lower right are incidental. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
